mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0%, it signals severe labor market distress triggering aggressive monetary policy responses that compress discount rates and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts above 580 and retail sales above 340,000 signals broad-based economic recovery, reducing recession risk and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 580 and RSAFS > 340000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, industrial production above 98.0 signals strengthening manufacturing activity, reducing double-dip recession risk and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 98.0 during the post-recession recovery period (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 13000 signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 13000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index falls below 216.0, it signals deflationary pressures prompting additional monetary stimulus that compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 216.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls above 130000 and decline in unemployment rate below 10.5 signals a strengthening labor market, reducing recession risk and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 and UNRATE < 10.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery, housing starts above 580 signals improving residential construction activity, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 580 during the housing market recovery period (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
